title: L2 — Pipeline Observability & Debug
description: Pipeline debug dashboard. Default view: risk-scoring pipeline with a known failed trace. Select Domain → Pipeline to explore other pipelines. Click any Trace ID in the Runs table to load the full trace below.

list.name: product
list.label: Data Product
list.description: Select the data product whose SLO metrics are shown in the correlation panel.

list.name: pipeline_id
list.label: Pipeline
list.description: Select a pipeline to view its runs, metrics, and trace data.

list.name: trace_id
list.label: Trace ID
list.description: Paste a Trace ID, or click any row in the Runs table to auto-fill.

panels.title: Run Rate — Success vs Failure
panels.description: Run throughput. Failure spikes indicate reliability incidents.

panels.title: Pipeline Duration — per Run
panels.description: Last observed run duration. Sustained growth = regression or data volume increase.

panels.title: PIPELINE RUNS — Click a Trace ID row to load the waterfall below
Pipeline Runs
panels.description: All runs for the selected pipeline, live from Tempo. Click the **Trace ID** cell (blue) to load the full trace below.

panels.title: TRACE DETAIL — ${trace_id}     ·     ↑ Click a Trace ID above to change run
Span Waterfall — Extract → Transform → Load
panels.description: Full trace for the selected run. Red bars = failed spans. Click any span bar to see attributes: row count, source, target, error message.

panels.title: Phase Spans — Duration & Status
panels.description: ETL phase breakdown. ERROR = this phase caused the failure.

panels.title: Root Cause Summary
panels.description: Spans with ERROR status. If empty, all phases succeeded.

panels.title: DQ Events
panels.description: DQ check events on the etl.extract span for this run. Empty = no violations.

panels.title: End-to-End Latency
panels.description: End-to-end latency from produce to consume.

panels.title: Pipeline Logs
panels.description: Loki logs filtered by pipeline. Set trace_id to narrow to a single run.
